attributes.action: Prioritise doctors married to UK citizens for medical specialty training
attributes.additional_details:
Many doctors working in the NHS on a spouse visa, married to British citizens, are fully committed to the UK and have served their communities for years. Under current rules, they are not included in the priority groups for 2027 specialty training, despite their NHS experience and family ties. 
 
We ask the Government to include them within the priority groups for training - recognising their service. This could help the NHS retain skilled, experienced doctors who have already made the UK their home.
attributes.background: Provide doctors married to UK citizens and working in the NHS on a spouse visa priority status for 2027 speciality medical training programmes. Many call the UK home, deliver vital care, and we believe their NHS service and family commitment should count - not just visa status.
